name: ChatGPT Finances
desc: Link your accounts and ask questions grounded in your own money.
desc_zh: 连接你的账户，然后就自己的收支直接提问。
solves: A spending question needs every statement open at once. Finances holds the connected picture, so you ask about a charge and get an answer with your numbers in it.
solves_zh: 问一句花钱的情况，过去要把所有账单同时打开。Finances 保存连接后的全貌，你问某笔扣款，答案里就带着你自己的数字。
best_for: A charge shows up that you do not recognise, or a budget needs redoing.
best_for_zh: 出现一笔你不认识的扣款，或者预算得重做一遍。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 ChatGPT release notes, entry under the "May 15, 2026" heading. Announced as "Personal finances in ChatGPT", surfaced as the Finances page. Read-only: ChatGPT cannot move money or place trades. US only at launch, expanded to Free and Go on 2026-10-02. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
